modelNotes: Rebounds Board 1.0 uses season rebounds, last 5 rebounds, last 10 rebounds, expected minutes, minutes confidence, position role, and recent rebound trend.
Rebounds Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent rebound rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Antetokounmpo (wrist) is listed as probable for Saturday's game against Detroit.
injury.detail: Antetokounmpo has been a mainstay on the injury report of late with a right wrist sprain, though he's expected to play in the second leg of this back-to-back set. The superstar forward is coming off a 37-point effort and has averaged 28.8 points, 12.3 rebounds, 4.3 assists and 2.1 combined steals-plus-blocks per game through six outings in November.

injury.shortComment: Edey won't play in Friday's game against the Pelicans due to left ankle injury management.
injury.detail: Edey will get the night off after appearing in eight straight games for the Grizzlies. Isaiah Stewart and Taylor Hendricks are next in line for minutes at center considering both Edey and Quinten Post (concussion) are listed out for Friday.

injury.shortComment: Allen (knee) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against Dallas.
injury.detail: Allen has played in each of Cleveland's last three games after sitting out two contests with a right knee injury, but lingering issues have now put his availability for Saturday's game in jeopardy. Thomas Bryant and Mario Hezonja could take on increased playing time if Allen ends up sitting.

injury.shortComment: Smith (finger) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game at Minnesota.
injury.detail: Smith is in jeopardy of missing Saturday's contest after aggravating his sprained left finger in Friday's overtime win over Atlanta. With Nic Claxton (hamstring) also questionable, the Bulls could be shorthanded in the frontcourt. If either of those guys is ruled out, Zach Collins would likely see increased burn.

injury.shortComment: Claxton (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Timberwolves.
injury.detail: Claxton has averaged 7.7 points, 5.3 rebounds, 2.3 assists and 1.3 blocks in 18.7 minutes across three games since making his season debut Sunday, but the Bulls may hold him out of Saturday's contest as he continues to manage the hamstring injury that forced him to miss Chicago's first eight games. Zach Collins could work in an expanded role if Claxton doesn't play.

injury.shortComment: Johnson (left shin contusion) is listed as probable for Saturday against Cleveland.
injury.detail: Johnson appears to be trending toward availability after recently missing one game due to the shin injury. The rookie has averaged 6.9 points and 4.8 rebounds in 16.7 minutes per game this season, limiting his appeal to deeper fantasy formats.

injury.shortComment: Mitchell (knee) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Mavericks.
injury.detail: Mitchell is dealing with a left knee contusion and could sit out the second leg of this back-to-back set. The star guard's absence would open up more minutes for guys like Meleek Thomas and Tyrese Proctor. James Harden (lower leg/calf), Peyton Watson (hamstring) and Jarrett Allen (knee) are all also in danger of joining Evan Mobley (toe) and Sam Merrill (elbow) on the shelf, so Cleveland could be shorthanded against Dallas.

injury.shortComment: Watson supplied seven points (2-12 FG, 2-5 3Pt, 1-2 FT), five rebounds, four assists and four blocks over 30 minutes in Wednesday's 115-107 win over the Knicks.
injury.detail: Despite a shaky shooting performance, Watson made a huge impact defensively with a season-high-tying four swats. The forward has particularly been a strong defensive presence for the Cavaliers, averaging 11.0 points, 4.6 rebounds, 2.8 assists and 1.7 blocks per contest in 10 games this season.

injury.shortComment: Harden (left lower leg/calf tightness) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Mavericks.
injury.detail: Harden could be held out of the second leg of this back-to-back set. If the veteran guard is ruled out, Tyrese Proctor and Craig Porter would likely see increased playing time. Donovan Mitchell (knee), Peyton Watson (hamstring) and Jarrett Allen (knee) are all also in jeopardy of joining Evan Mobley (toe) and Sam Merrill (elbow) on the inactive list, so the Cavaliers could be shorthanded Saturday.

injury.shortComment: Larsson (illness) is listed as doubtful for Saturday's game against Detroit.
injury.detail: Larsson is expected to miss a second consecutive contest due to an illness. If he's ultimately ruled out, Myron Gardner and Andrew Wiggins would be candidates to see increased playing time.

injury.shortComment: Powell (back) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against Minnesota.
injury.detail: After erupting for 33 points in 31 minutes during Friday's overtime win over the Hawks, Powell is in danger of missing the second leg of this back-to-back set due to lower-back injury management. If the veteran guard is ruled out, Buddy Hield and Tre Jones could see increased burn.

injury.shortComment: Post (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against New Orleans.
injury.detail: Post will miss a second straight game while in the league's concussion protocol, and his next opportunity to play will come Saturday against Brooklyn. With Zach Edey (left ankle injury management) sitting out the front end of this back-to-back set, Isaiah Stewart will likely get the starting nod, while Taylor Hendricks figures to see increased burn off the bench.

injury.shortComment: Traore (calf) is listed as probable for Saturday's game against Memphis.
injury.detail: Traore appears on track to suit up despite dealing with discomfort in his right calf. The guard's expected availability should help Brooklyn maintain its backcourt depth, though his fantasy appeal remains dependent on his playing time and opportunities in the rotation. His status should be confirmed ahead of Saturday's tipoff.

injury.shortComment: Brown (illness) has been upgraded to probable for Saturday's game at Memphis.
injury.detail: After initially being listed as questionable due to an illness, Brown is trending in the right direction following a two-game absence. The rookie guard's return would leave fewer minutes available for Keon Ellis and Terance Mann. Brown has averaged 15.2 points, 3.8 assists and 2.0 rebounds in 24.6 minutes per tilt over his last five outings.

injury.shortComment: Thompson (ankle) is listed as probable for Saturday's game against the Pistons.
injury.detail: Thompson missed the front end of this back-to-back set due to a left ankle sprain, though he's trending toward playing Saturday. If the veteran sharpshooter is cleared to play, there would be fewer minutes available for the likes of Ryan Conwell, Tim Hardaway and Myron Gardner.

injury.shortComment: Christie (ankle) has been downgraded to doubtful for Saturday's game against the Cavaliers
injury.detail: Christie was initially listed as questionable for Saturday's contest due to a left ankle sprain, but it now appears likely that he'll miss the front end of his back-to-back set. Zaccharie Risacher and Naji Marshall stand to benefit from extra playing time if Christie sits.
